name: Círdan the Shipwright
oracle_text:
Vigilance
Secret council — Whenever Círdan enters or attacks, each player secretly votes for a player, then those votes are revealed. Each player draws a card for each vote they received. Each player who received no votes may put a permanent card from their hand onto the battlefield.
blocked_sentences: Secret council — Whenever Círdan enters or attacks, each player secretly votes for a player, then those votes are revealed. Each player draws a card for each vote they received. Each player who received no votes may put a permanent card from their hand onto the battlefield

needs.what: a vote op where each player (here secretly, revealed simultaneously) votes for a player, with the tally bound so later effects can read it per player: a value 'votes received by <each_player>' for 'draws a card for each vote they received', and a condition/player filter for 'received no votes' feeding a for_each_player whose may lets that player put a permanent card from their hand onto the battlefield
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_player is made by one player only and binds a single choice; for_each_player wrapping choose_player has no way to aggregate the choices into a per-player vote count, and no value_key or condition reads votes received; join_forces collects payments, not choices
